title: Understanding Content Moderation in Large Language Models through Restricted Books: From Refusal to Warning
reasoning: The paper evaluates how LLMs handle culturally contested content (restricted books) and measures how they encode and apply societal values and normative judgments when moderating this content. It also explicitly tracks and evaluates how LLMs flag and discuss content categories like religion, ethics, and social themes (e.g., race, LGBTQ+).
